name: James Joyce Bridge
facts: James Joyce Bridge, a 40‑metre steel marvel, was unveiled on 16 June 2003, the very day of Bloomsday, celebrating the author it honors.
Designed by Santiago Calatrava, the bridge’s two outward‑angled arches echo an open book, a subtle nod to Joyce’s literary legacy.
Constructed by Irishenco Construction, the bridge’s prefabricated steel sections were fabricated at Harland and Wolff in Belfast, showcasing international collaboration.
